question: In January 2017, among visitors whose campaign name contains 'Data Share' and who accessed any page starting with '/home', which page did they most commonly visit next, and what is the maximum time (in seconds) they spent on the '/home' page before moving on?
sql:
WITH all_page_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    visitNumber,
    h.hitNumber,
    h.time,
    h.type,
    h.page.pagePath
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170131'
    AND LOWER(trafficSource.campaign) LIKE '%data share%'
    AND h.page.pagePath IS NOT NULL
    AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
hits_with_next AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    visitNumber,
    hitNumber,
    time,
    type,
    pagePath,
    LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) as next_time,
    LEAD(pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId, visitId ORDER BY hitNumber) as next_pagePath
  FROM all_page_hits
),
home_with_next AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    visitNumber,
    hitNumber,
    time as homeTime,
    pagePath as homePagePath,
    next_time,
    next_pagePath
  FROM hits_with_next
  WHERE LOWER(pagePath) LIKE '/home%'
    AND next_time IS NOT NULL
),
most_common_next AS (
  SELECT next_pagePath
  FROM home_with_next
  GROUP BY next_pagePath
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  mc.next_pagePath as most_common_next_page,
  (SELECT MAX(hwn.next_time - hwn.homeTime) FROM home_with_next hwn) as max_time_on_home_seconds
FROM home_with_next hwn
JOIN most_common_next mc ON hwn.next_pagePath = mc.next_pagePath
GROUP BY mc.next_pagePath
LIMIT 1
